title: HOUSE_OUT
description: Output contract of House Engine (10_HOUSE_ENGINE.md). Consumed by Video Engine and Render Engine.

source_type.description: LIBRARY_REUSE confirmed in spec examples; AI_GENERATED is the implied counterpart for the newly-generated path (not explicitly named in source doc -- flagged gap, confirm naming before wiring real code).

provider.description: KLING_IMAGE is not in 16_PROVIDER_INTERFACE.md's registry -- added 2026-07-29 because Kling's /v1/images/generations covers House Engine on credit that already exists, avoiding a second image-provider account. Add it to the provider registry in Phase 0.

prompt.description: Must never contain price, phone number, or broker contact details.

seed.description: Store the generation seed for reproducibility -- required by Best Practices even though absent from the example JSON.

x-error-codes.ERR_HOU_01: Image generation API timeout/rejected -- switch to backup provider (e.g. Flux 1 Dev fails -> try SDXL or Midjourney)
x-error-codes.ERR_HOU_02: Library empty for that style AND generation also fails -- pull a Default Concept Image for that architectural style

x-hard-rules: Always check house_library before invoking any paid generation API (Library-First).
Never include price or broker contact details in the image-generation prompt.
Keep images neutral -- no cars, people, for-sale signs.
Randomize and store the seed alongside the image for reproducibility.
